g.text: Linking benefits depend on context and fit measure
Novel focus study · each cell is linking fit minus no-linking fit within the same context.
Blue = higher fit with linking Red = lower fit with linking 0 (tie) = equal fit
All three measures use the same 30 equally weighted pairs within each context. Pearson and Spearman use matching aggregation here.
The two correlation panels share a color scale; log score has its own scale. Cell values are rounded; exact ties use tolerance 10⁻¹².
Corrected Qwen2-7B results · saved held-out predictions · Set K = 20 · descriptive differences, without significance or noninferiority tests.
